task_fulfillment.rationale: The workbook substantially delivers the requested calculation and comparison. However, it makes nomination conditional on reopening technical capability already established by the brief, an unnecessary utility hold. The input-update route also overstates automatic consistency: narrative NPVs and recommendation are static, and the primary Solimoto price tier follows tooling input B9 rather than its separately labelled threshold B12. Remove the redundant technical gate and make updates consistent before operational reuse. Rendering and spreadsheet-engine recalculation remain separate, unvalidated endpoints.
